storage_classification.sqlite_full: Real SQLITE_FULL through canonical connection max_page_count; not physical host-volume exhaustion
storage_classification.injected_sync_eio: Owned-child exact SQLite inode fsync/F_FULLFSYNC EIO; not a physical storage device failure
storage_classification.damaged_ledger: Controlled corruption of the owned SQLite header; reopening must not reinitialize
storage_classification.incompatible_checkpoint: Controlled unsupported checkpoint schema version; reopening must not repair
